items.title: Owls in the NFL - Week 5
items.summary: It was a Monday Night Football thriller as left tackle Dion Dawkins (2013-16), running back Ray Davis (2019-20), safety Sam Franklin (2016-19), and the Buffalo Bills defeated the Los Angeles Rams on a walk-off field goal in overtime. Davis set the tone early, returning the opening kickoff 70 yards to the Rams' 26-yard line to set up an eventual field goal. He also hauled in a 31-yard reception in the fourth quarter
